caption: The drawing features a cylindrical container with a fitted, round lid. The main body and the lid of the container are a reddish-brown color, resembling terracotta or painted wood. The container is decorated with three horizontal decorative bands—one near the top, one around the middle, and one near the bottom. These bands are dark green in color and adorned with a wavy, vine-like pattern that includes small, pale orange or peach-colored dots or berries at intervals along the vines. The structure of the container is accentuated with vertical lines that divide its surface into panels. The background is plain and light-colored, providing contrast to the object. The drawing includes a small, neat signature and date in the lower right corner: "E. A. Sheldady 1908."
title: Pa. German Pail and Cover
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
